newsitem.title: UK: Nigeria signs six more crude export contracts.
newsitem.headline: Nigeria signs six more crude export contracts.

text.p: Nigerian National Petroleum Corp (NNPC) has signed half a dozen term crude contracts for combined export volumes of about 120,000 barrels per day (bpd), a senior NNPC official said on Friday.
The official said he expected more contracts to be signed soon to replace contracts which expired in March and September of last year.
Two or three of the new contracts signed were renewals of old contracts and three or four were with new NNPC customers, he said.
NNPC cancelled 21 contracts in March of last year and another 12 in September, but rolled them forward month by month awaiting a decision from central government in Abuja.
The six new contracts took NNPC's total to 14 current contracts with other expired contracts still being rolled forward, the NNPC official said.
